prompt: Say: She is a teacher.
correctAnswer: Hon är lärare.
hints: No article before a profession after 'är'.

prompt: Say: They are my friends.
correctAnswer: De är mina vänner.
hints: 'Är' has the same form for all persons; 'mina' agrees with the plural 'vänner'.

prompt: Say: I do not like coffee.
correctAnswer: Jag gillar inte kaffe.
hints: 'Inte' comes right after the verb in a main clause.

prompt: Say: We are students.
correctAnswer: Vi är studenter.
hints: 'Är' is the same for every person; 'student' → 'studenter'.

prompt: Han ___ engelska varje dag.
correctAnswer: studerar
hints: Swedish present tense ends in -r for every person.

prompt: Say: There is a book on the table.
correctAnswer: Det finns en bok på bordet.
hints: 'Det finns' = there is/are; for objects lying somewhere Swedes often say 'Det ligger'.
acceptedAnswers: Det ligger en bok på bordet.

prompt: Ask: Do you like tea?
correctAnswer: Gillar du te?
hints: Swedish yes/no questions start with the verb: 'Gillar du ...?'

prompt: Hon har ___ paraply.
correctAnswer: ett
hints: 'Paraply' is an ett-word (neuter).

prompt: Say: I am not tired.
correctAnswer: Jag är inte trött.
hints: 'Inte' follows the verb: 'Jag är inte'.

prompt: Say: The cats are sleeping.
correctAnswer: Katterna sover.
hints: Swedish uses the simple present for actions in progress.

prompt: Say: She goes to school every day.
correctAnswer: Hon går till skolan varje dag.
hints: 'Går' is the same for every person; 'till skolan' = to school.

prompt: Say: They are happy.
correctAnswer: De är lyckliga.
hints: Adjectives take -a in the plural: 'glad' → 'glada'.

prompt: Ask: Is this sentence correct?
correctAnswer: Är den här meningen korrekt?
hints: Grammar-check question.

prompt: Say: I went to the supermarket yesterday.
correctAnswer: Jag gick till stormarknaden igår.
hints: 'Gick' is the irregular past tense of 'gå'.

prompt: Say: She has been waiting for an hour.
correctAnswer: Hon har väntat i en timme.
hints: Swedish uses the perfect (har väntat) for an action still going on.

prompt: Say: If it rains, we will stay inside.
correctAnswer: Om det regnar stannar vi inne.
hints: Swedish often uses the present for the future; note the inverted 'stannar vi'.
acceptedAnswers: Om det regnar kommer vi att stanna inne.

prompt: I lördags ___ jag på bio.
correctAnswer: gick
hints: Past tense of 'gå'; the verb comes second, so 'gick jag'.

prompt: Say: At seven this morning he was working.
correctAnswer: Klockan sju i morse jobbade han.
hints: Swedish has no continuous tense; use the past or 'höll på att'.
acceptedAnswers: Han jobbade klockan sju i morse.
Klockan sju i morse höll han på att jobba.

prompt: Say: We have lived here for five years.
correctAnswer: Vi har bott här i fem år.
hints: Perfect tense (har bott) + 'i' for a duration up to now.

prompt: Den här boken är ___ intressant än den andra.
correctAnswer: mer
hints: Long adjectives use 'mer' for the comparative.

prompt: Ask: Have you been to Paris?
correctAnswer: Har du varit i Paris?
hints: 'Har du varit i' + place = have you been to.
acceptedAnswers: Har du någonsin varit i Paris?

prompt: Say: She used to play the piano when she was young.
correctAnswer: Hon brukade spela piano när hon var ung.
hints: 'Used to' expresses a past habit that no longer continues.

prompt: Say: You should drink more water.
correctAnswer: Du bör dricka mer vatten.
hints: 'Bör/borde' + infinitive without 'att'.

prompt: Say: I have lived here for two years.
correctAnswer: Jag har bott här i två år.
hints: Present perfect for duration.

prompt: Say: If it rains, we will stay home.
correctAnswer: Om det regnar kommer vi att stanna hemma.
hints: First conditional pattern.

prompt: Jag har ___ vänner i Stockholm.
correctAnswer: många
hints: 'Många' with countable nouns, 'mycket' with uncountable.

prompt: Say: If I had more time, I would learn a third language.
correctAnswer: Om jag hade mer tid skulle jag lära mig ett tredje språk.
hints: 'Om' + past tense, then 'skulle' + infinitive; note the inverted 'skulle jag'.

prompt: Say: By the time she arrives, we will have finished dinner.
correctAnswer: När hon kommer har vi redan ätit klart.
hints: Swedish often uses the present perfect for a future completed action.
acceptedAnswers: När hon kommer kommer vi att ha ätit klart.

prompt: Say: Despite feeling tired, she continued working.
correctAnswer: Trots att hon var trött fortsatte hon att arbeta.
hints: 'Trots att' + clause, or 'trots' + noun.
acceptedAnswers: Trots tröttheten fortsatte hon att jobba.

prompt: Rapporten ___ av teamet förra veckan.
correctAnswer: skrevs
hints: The s-passive in the past tense: 'skrev' + s.

prompt: Say: He told me that he had already sent the email.
correctAnswer: Han berättade för mig att han redan hade skickat e-postmeddelandet.
hints: Reported speech shifts tense: 'has sent' → 'had sent'.

prompt: Say: I wish I had more time to practice.
correctAnswer: Jag önskar att jag hade mer tid att öva.
hints: 'Önska att' + past tense for an unreal present wish.

prompt: Say: Not only did she win the race, but she also broke the record.
correctAnswer: Hon vann inte bara loppet, utan slog också rekordet.
hints: 'Inte bara ... utan också' = not only ... but also.
acceptedAnswers: Inte nog med att hon vann loppet, hon slog också rekordet.

prompt: Say: She is used to waking up early.
correctAnswer: Hon är van vid att vakna tidigt.
hints: 'Vara van vid att' + infinitive = to be used to doing.

prompt: Say: The meeting was canceled owing to the poor weather conditions.
correctAnswer: Mötet ställdes in på grund av de dåliga väderförhållandena.
hints: 'Owing to' is a formal way of saying 'because of'.

prompt: Personen ___ ringde lämnade inget meddelande.
correctAnswer: som
hints: 'Som' is the relative pronoun for both people and things.

prompt: Say: I wish I had more time to practice.
correctAnswer: Jag önskar att jag hade mer tid att öva.
hints: Use past form after 'wish' for present unreal situations.

prompt: Say: The report that you sent was very helpful.
correctAnswer: Den rapport som du skickade var till stor hjälp.
hints: Relative clause example.

prompt: När ska jag använda ___ form?
correctAnswer: passiv
hints: Indefinite common-gender adjective agreeing with 'form'.

prompt: Say: Had I known about the delay, I would have taken an earlier train.
correctAnswer: Hade jag vetat om förseningen hade jag tagit ett tidigare tåg.
hints: Inverted third conditional: 'Had I...' replaces 'If I had...'

prompt: Say: Rarely have I seen such attention to detail.
correctAnswer: Sällan har jag sett en sådan uppmärksamhet på detaljer.
hints: The verb comes second in Swedish: after 'Sällan' comes 'har jag'.

prompt: Say: The proposal, which had been drafted over several months, was ultimately rejected.
correctAnswer: Förslaget, som utarbetats under flera månader, avvisades slutligen.
hints: Non-defining relative clause in commas; past perfect passive.

prompt: Say: No sooner had she arrived than the meeting began.
correctAnswer: Hon hade knappt kommit förrän mötet började.
hints: 'Knappt ... förrän' = no sooner ... than.

prompt: Say: It is high time we addressed the underlying structural issues.
correctAnswer: Det är hög tid att vi behandlar de underliggande strukturella frågorna.
hints: 'Det är hög tid att' + clause; Swedish keeps normal tense here.

prompt: Uppgifterna måste ___ innan några slutsatser kan dras.
correctAnswer: analyseras
hints: Modal + s-passive infinitive.

prompt: Say: Were she to apply, she would be a strong candidate for the position.
correctAnswer: Om hon skulle söka tjänsten vore hon en stark kandidat.
hints: Inverted conditional with 'were to' for formal, hypothetical situations.
acceptedAnswers: Om hon sökte tjänsten skulle hon vara en stark kandidat.

prompt: Say: The more you practice, the more fluent you become.
correctAnswer: Ju mer du övar, desto mer flytande blir du.
hints: 'Ju ... desto ...' = the more ... the more ...

prompt: Say: Had I known earlier, I would have prepared differently.
correctAnswer: Hade jag vetat tidigare hade jag förberett mig annorlunda.
hints: Inverted third conditional.

prompt: Hon blev inte bara klar i tid, ___ hon förbättrade också utkastet.
correctAnswer: utan
hints: 'Inte bara ... utan också' = not only ... but also.

prompt: Dialogue: In grammar class, you ask your teacher about moving a phrase to the start of a sentence.
correctAnswer: Hur förändras betoningen när vi flyttar fram en fras till början av meningen?
hints: Advanced grammar awareness question.
answerEnglish: How does the emphasis change when we move a phrase to the start of the sentence?
